objective: Test whether prior U.S. equity information has session-specific rather than universal directional effects on JNU intraday returns.

direct_evidence.paper: Yasuhiro Iwanaga (2026), How the prior day's S&P 500 returns influence the intraday returns of Nikkei 225 futures
direct_evidence.precommitted_implication: Separate FIRST_30M and LAST_30M. Do not use a fixed all-session U.S.-equity sign.

direct_evidence.paper: Becker, Finnerty & Tucker (1992), The intraday interdependence structure between U.S. and Japanese equity markets
direct_evidence.precommitted_implication: Prior-U.S. effect is concentrated early in the Japanese session rather than uniform through the day.

direct_evidence.paper: Li, Endo & Zuo (2010), Order imbalances explain 90% of returns of Nikkei 225 futures
direct_evidence.precommitted_implication: Order imbalance is a future venue-level explanatory candidate, but cannot be proxied from OHLC bars.

required_data.primary: True OSE JNU or Nikkei 225 mini/large minute bars with approved provenance
required_data.external: Prior completed U.S. cash-session S&P 500 return; ES may be tested only as a separately preregistered proxy
preferred_source_order: 225Labo personal-use OSE minute data after access/storage-rights review
Index proxies may be used for methodology sanity checks only, never formal JNU promotion

FIRST_30M.definition: First 30 elapsed trading minutes of the OSE day session

MIDDLE.definition: All eligible day-session minutes excluding FIRST_30M and LAST_30M, with lunch/break treatment explicitly separated by exchange schedule

LAST_30M.definition: Final 30 elapsed trading minutes of the OSE day session

primary_hypotheses.predictor: Prior completed S&P 500 cash-session close-to-close return, continuous
Prior completed S&P 500 cash-session close-to-close return, continuous

primary_hypotheses.test: Compare universal-sign model with time-state interaction model
primary_hypotheses.expected_result: State interaction should add OOS information if the direct evidence generalizes.

forbidden_generation1: Switch S&P 500 to NQ after seeing results
Add technical indicators to rescue a failed state interaction
Use order-imbalance claims without actual trade/order-side data
Promote an index-proxy result as formal JNU evidence

evaluation.method: Expanding or anchored walk-forward OOS with fixed state definitions
metrics: OOS MSE improvement vs state-only baseline
Block-bootstrap confidence for incremental loss improvement
evaluation.trading_gate: Only after information/prediction gate passes: include JNU fees, spread and slippage; require positive incremental EV.
evaluation.multiple_testing: Treat H1-H3 as one preregistered family; any future altered window or U.S. proxy becomes a new family member.

role_if_passed: Session/path conditional layer; not a standalone always-on direction model.
formal_promotion_requires: True JNU/OSE minute data and full OOS/cost/overfit gates.
